unscoredIds.reason: 2026-10-27 Fibonacci anyon CNOT compiler, leakage about 10^{-10} at length 69 in their search. Not an S3 braid-plus-fusion gate. Score only if a later card can bind it without treating Fibonacci as S3. Over the 15-card cap after the twelve carry-overs.
2026-10-26 AlgebrasTQD, GAP code for condensable algebras of twisted quantum doubles, including non-Abelian surface-code gates. E-QEC candidate. Do not auto-open nonabelian-qldpc. Over the cap.

2026-10-23 Trident load verification for yoked surface codes. E-QEC architecture. ACM DOI 10.1145/3845814.3850031 resolved this run; that is a conference identifier, not a journal, so it would not pass A5. Over the cap.
2026-10-21 Injection of resource states for parallel universal logic in concatenated high-rate CSS codes. E-QEC architecture, simulation only. Over the cap.
2026-10-23 Junction hook errors in the triangular color code, distances 7, 9, and 11. E-QEC. Over the cap.
2026-10-26 Self-correcting 3D surface code with local dimension growing as Θ(N). E-QEC theory. The growing dimension is not a device. Over the cap.
2026-10-23 Tokamak-SI, a DIII-D label catalog for AE, ELM, tearing, and related events. E-RL context, not a closed control loop. Over the cap.
2026-10-23 Quantum secret sharing from CSS qLDPC codes. Uses qLDPC as an access structure, not as the error layer. Over the cap.

2026-10-26 Journal version in Physical Review E 114, 044136 (DOI 10.1103/xhzy-hxdw). Bimodal Maxwellian reactivity about a factor of two above a single Maxwellian at low energy for D-D and D-T. Not an S-L3 solver and not a Q_eng result. Do not adopt. Over the cap.
2026-10-22 Experimental forward energy transfer in tokamak turbulence (CTS and DBS). Not a control loop and not a Vlasov, hole-burning, SRS, or SBS method. Over the cap.
2026-10-27 Time-domain anyonic interference versus dephasing in a fractional quantum Hall proposal. Not an S3 gate. Over the cap.
2026-10-27 AnyFormer neural wavefunctions for continuum semions. Abelian statistics, not S3. Over the cap.
2026-10-21 AnyonWiki.org fusion-category database. A resource, not a braid or fusion measurement. Over the cap.
2026-10-23 Edge-to-vortex transition in 2M-WS2 superconducting rings. E-MZM context. No X and Z logical. Over the cap.
2026-10-21 Cr chains on Bi2Pd. Zero-bias end modes and a localization length of about three sites. E-MZM context, not an X and Z logical. Over the cap.
